'''Broadband transceivers''' were [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] dedicated to scanning communications channels, such as [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]], subspace bands and radionics frequencies. They attempted to find transmissions that were hidden by natural [[X-ray/Legends|x-rays]] or background static.<ref name="EGWT" />
